title: Demographic "Doomsday" Misses the Mark
summary: This Science journal article challenges pessimistic demographic predictions, arguing that alarmist forecasts about population decline, aging societies, or population 'doomsday' scenarios are overly simplistic and miss nuanced demographic trends and potential societal adaptations.
problem_solved: Addresses widespread misconceptions and fearmongering about demographic decline and population aging that dominate public discourse
why_valuable: Provides evidence-based counterarguments to demographic pessimism, helping readers understand complex population dynamics beyond headlines
